paper_title: Exceeding 14% Efficiency for Solution-Processed Tandem Organic Solar Cells Combining Fullerene- and Nonfullerene-Based Subcells with Complementary Absorption

knowledge_points.content: PBD1 is a wide-bandgap (WBG) conjugated polymer with an optical bandgap of 1.88 eV and a low-lying HOMO energy level of -5.39 eV, designed for use in the front subcell of tandem organic solar cells.
knowledge_points.evidence: This WBG polymer, referred to as PBD1 (Figure 1a), exhibited a wide optical bandgap (Eg opt) of 1.88 eV, a low-lying highest occupied molecular orbital (HOMO) energy level of −5.39 eV.

knowledge_points.content: A single-junction organic solar cell based on PBD1:PC71BM with a thickness of 230 nm achieves a PCE of 9.8%, a Jsc of 14.6 mA cm⁻², and a fill factor (FF) of 74%.
knowledge_points.evidence: The optimized device that was based on PBD1:PC71BM with a thickness of 230 nm exhibited a high PCE of 9.8% with a high Jsc of 14.6 mA cm−2, a Voc of 0.91 V, and a FF of 74%.

knowledge_points.content: The solution-processed tandem organic solar cell reaches a PCE of 14.2% with a Voc of 1.61 V, a Jsc of 12.3 mA cm⁻², and a fill factor of 72%.
knowledge_points.evidence: The best performance of the tandem cell gave Jsc of 12.3 mA cm−2, a Voc of 1.61 V, and a high FF of 72%, resulting in an overall PCE of 14.2%.

knowledge_points.content: PBD1 exhibits a high hole mobility of 1.4 × 10⁻³ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ and a preferential face-on orientation with a π-π stacking distance of 3.73 Å.
knowledge_points.evidence: a high hole mobility of 1.4 × 10−3 cm2 V−1 s−1... suggesting that the polymer had a preferential face-on orientation relative to the substrate with a π-π stacking distance of 3.73 Å.

knowledge_points.content: The tandem device employs an interconnecting layer (ICL) consisting of a 30 nm ZnO-NP layer and a 30 nm pH-neutral PEDOT:PSS (N-PEDOT:PSS) layer.
knowledge_points.evidence: The ICL consisted of a 30 nm layer ZnO-NPs processed from n-butanol and a 30 nm layer of pH-neutral poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene):polystyrene sulfonate (N-PEDOT:PSS) spin coated by water/isopropanol.

knowledge_points.content: The tandem configuration utilizes complementary absorption where the PBD1:PC71BM front cell absorbs photons from 300 to 650 nm and the PTB7-Th:IEICO-4F rear cell absorbs from 650 to 1000 nm.
knowledge_points.evidence: The simulation showed that the energy distribution in the front cell was primarily located at a wavelength of 300−650 nm, while the rear cell... was primarily located in the region of 650−1000 nm.

knowledge_points.content: Optimal thickness for the tandem subcells, determined by transfer-matrix modeling and experimental verification, is 230 nm for the front active layer and 110 nm for the rear active layer.
knowledge_points.evidence: The optical simulation showed that an optimum value of over 12 mA cm−2 was obtained when the optimal thicknesses of the active layers in the front and rear cells were 230 and 110 nm respectively.

knowledge_points.content: Morphology of the PBD1:PC71BM blend is optimized using 1,8-diiodooctane (DIO) additive and thermal annealing, which creates a continuous interpenetrating network with fibrous features.
knowledge_points.evidence: Compared to the as-cast blend film, the film with DIO and thermal annealing treatment showed a continuous interpenetrating network with fibrous features, which is beneficial for exciton dissociation and charge transport.

knowledge_points.content: The spectrally averaged internal quantum efficiency (IQE) for the PBD1:PC71BM active layer is 95%, while for PTB7-Th:IEICO-4F it is 85%.
knowledge_points.evidence: The spectrally averaged internal quantum efficiency (IQE) values for each active layer were 95% for PBD1:PC71BM and 85% for PTB7-Th:IEICO-4F.

knowledge_points.content: Large-area tandem organic solar cells with an active area of 1.12 cm² (shadow mask aperture of 0.64 cm²) maintain high performance with a PCE of 13.0%.
knowledge_points.evidence: tandem devices with a large active area were fabricated, and a PCE of 13.0% was obtained for devices with a 1.12 cm2 area.
